title: Synthesis, in vitro and in silico studies of transition metal complexes of chrysin with potent anticancer activity via GSK3beta phosphorylation, modulation of p38 MAPK pathway and HDAC8 inhibition.
authors: Break, Mohammed Khaled Bin; Hossan, Md Shahadat; Ansari, Siddique Akber; Faisal, Amir; Katamesh, Ahmed A; Khoo, Teng-Jin; Nawaz, Muhammad; Anwar, Sirajudheen; Albadari, Najah; Elariny, Hemat A; Alsultan, Ibrahim M; Alghamdi, Omar A; Alrshidi, Mazi Abdullah; Musa, Mustapha; Bradshaw, Tracey D
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦黄酮金属配合物的抗癌活性与信号通路调控，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白/酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The present study involved the synthesis of Cu(II), Fe(II), Co(II), Zn(II) and Ni(II) complexes of chrysin as potential anticancer agents. The metal complexes were extensively characterised via FTIR, NMR, HRMS, elemental analysis, molar conductivity, SEM-EDX and TGA. They were initially screened against HCT116 (colon), CAL51 (breast) and MCF7 (breast) cancer cells. The highest activity was exerted by chrysin's nickel complex (NiC) against HCT116 with an IC(50) of 6.88 muM and a 2-fold enhancement in activity relative to chrysin. Moreover, NiC demonstrated lower toxicity towards normal HSF and OEC cells, with  approximately 5-fold selectivity towards HCT116. Further studies on HCT116 revealed that NiC induced S-phase arrest and necrosis, while Western blotting showed no effect on Bcl2 and caspase-3 expression, confirming the absence of apoptosis. NiC also increased gamma-H2AX expression, which is indicative of DNA damage, and resulted in reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation. Furthermore, NiC decreased PTEN expression and increased GSK3beta phosphorylation which led to inactivation of its tumour promotion effects. It also modulated p38 MAPK pathway via phosphorylation of tumour suppressors p38 and p53, while no effect was shown on beta-catenin. Finally, NiC potently inhibited HDAC8 enzyme with an IC(50) of 9.96 muM which was 4-fold more active than chrysin. Overall, NiC caused necrosis via modulation of PTEN/GSK3beta pathway, and also via inhibition of HDAC8 resulting in ROS generation, DNA damage, p38/p53 activation and S-phase arrest. DFT calculations, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation revealed that NiC possessed higher reactivity and affinity to its receptor with more extensive interactions than chrysin.
abstract_zh: 本研究涉及合成白杨素（chrysin）的Cu(II)、Fe(II)、Co(II)、Zn(II)和Ni(II)配合物，作为潜在抗癌剂。通过FTIR、NMR、HRMS、元素分析、摩尔电导率、SEM-EDX和TGA对金属配合物进行了全面表征。初步筛选了其对HCT116（结肠癌）、CAL51（乳腺癌）和MCF7（乳腺癌）癌细胞系的活性。白杨素的镍配合物（NiC）对HCT116表现出最高活性，IC(50)为6.88 μM，活性较白杨素提高2倍。此外，NiC对正常HSF和OEC细胞表现出较低毒性，对HCT116的选择性约为5倍。对HCT116的进一步研究表明，NiC诱导S期阻滞和坏死，而Western blotting显示其对Bcl2和caspase-3表达无影响，证实未发生凋亡。NiC还增加了γ-H2AX表达，表明DNA损伤，并导致活性氧（ROS）生成。此外，NiC降低了PTEN表达并增加GSK3β磷酸化，从而使其肿瘤促进作用失活。它还通过磷酸化肿瘤抑制因子p38和p53调节p38 MAPK通路，而对β-catenin无影响。最后，NiC有效抑制HDAC8酶，IC(50)为9.96 μM，活性比白杨素高4倍。总体而言，NiC通过调节PTEN/GSK3β通路以及抑制HDAC8导致ROS生成、DNA损伤、p38/p53激活和S期阻滞，从而引起坏死。DFT计算、分子对接和分子动力学模拟表明，NiC具有更高的反应性和受体亲和力，与白杨素相比相互作用更广泛。
